evidence: This track can be walked in either direction. This description details a clockwise circuit of the track.
Start the circuit track from the Silverpeaks Scenic Reserve car park. Take the left fork to follow the track in a clockwise direction.
Continue to follow the wooden routed River Track signs to stay on the new track to complete the circuit and return to the Silverpeaks Scenic Reserve car park.

doubts: Start and end: the Silverpeaks Scenic Reserve car park is a pull-off on the gravel road (Double Hill, Semple and Steep Hill roads) and no road-end feature matches it (F1 and F2 are where Possum Hut Route meets Mountain Track Road), so both refs are null. Direction: clockwise, as the page describes; the circuit can also be walked the other way, which is not recorded as a second way. The Jubilee Hut stop is reached by a 10 min spur from an intersection and the walk returns down the same spur to rejoin the circuit; the hut is kept in via and huts as the overnight stop. The creek on the valley floor is unnamed and the text does not say whether it is bridged, so no ford is recorded. The South Branch of the Waikouaiti River is crossed a couple of times, but the text does not say whether there are bridges, so no ford is recorded either. The ABC Cave side trip leaves from the intersection under the Cats Teeth, about 2.5 km from Jubilee Hut, which is recorded as the via 'ABC Cave intersection'. The Possum Hut side trip's departure point is not stated, so from is null. The Possum Hut is derelict and is not a hut for stays, so it is not in huts. The time is DOC's 12 hr; the section times (4.5 hr, 3 hr 50 min, 3 hr 45 min) are not summed.
